reasons.text: The preference tier Series B Preferred is fully paid ($19,999,999.79). Above this exit value, the next dollar goes to the next tier's preference (Series A Preferred).
The preference tier Series A Preferred is fully paid ($14,999,996.21). Above this exit value, the next dollar goes to the next tier's preference (Seed Preferred and Seed Preferred (SAFE shadow)).
The preference tier Seed Preferred and Seed Preferred (SAFE shadow) is fully paid ($4,424,999.33). Above this exit value, the next dollar goes to the residual, shared as common.

Common reaches $0.05 per share, the strike on the 490,000 options at that price. Above this exit value they are in the money and exercised: their holders pay the strike, which is added to the proceeds, and share in the residual as common.

Common reaches $0.11 per share, the strike on the 1,100,000 options at that price. Above this exit value they are in the money and exercised: their holders pay the strike, which is added to the proceeds, and share in the residual as common.

Common reaches $0.42 per share, the strike on the 2,800,000 options at that price. Above this exit value they are in the money and exercised: their holders pay the strike, which is added to the proceeds, and share in the residual as common.

Seed Preferred (SAFE shadow) converts to common. At this exit value its as-converted share (1,169,043 common shares at $0.5774 each = $674,999.64) equals its 1.5x preference of $674,999.64. Below it, staying preferred pays more; above it, converting pays more.

Seed Preferred converts to common. At this exit value its as-converted share (5,393,570 common shares at $0.6953 each = $3,749,999.69) equals its 1.5x preference of $3,749,999.69. Below it, staying preferred pays more; above it, converting pays more.

Series A Preferred reaches its cap: preference plus participation totals 2.75x its original issue price ($32,999,991.66). Above this exit value its payout stays flat until converting to common pays more.

Series A Preferred converts to common. At this exit value its as-converted share (6,576,234.36 common shares at $5.0181 each = $32,999,991.66) equals its capped payout of $32,999,991.66 (2.75x its original issue price). Below it, staying preferred pays more; above it, converting pays more.
